# RSB Rental Scooter Barcelona - Full LLM Reference

> Full AI-readable reference for RSB Rental Scooter Barcelona.

RSB Rental Scooter Barcelona is a local rental shop in Barcelona for scooter rental, inline skates rental, bike rental, roller skates rental, skateboard rental and longboard rental. The shop is located in Vila Olímpica del Poblenou, near Port Olímpic, Nova Icaria Beach and Barceloneta Beach.

This file is intended for AI assistants, language models, search engines and crawlers that need a fuller structured overview of the business, its services, its location, its public URLs and its rental benefits.

## Main website

https://rentalscooterbarcelona.com/

## Business identity

Service area: Barcelona.
Reviews: Rated 4.6/5 from 226 Google reviews.
Scooters: We rent petrol 50cc and 125cc scooters only. We do not rent electric kick scooters, e-scooters or e-bikes.
Bikes: Standard city bikes only; no e-bikes or electric bicycles.


- Business name: RSB Rental Scooter Barcelona
- Business type: Local rental shop in Barcelona
- Location: Carrer de Salvador Espriu, 63, 08005 Barcelona, Spain
- Area: Vila Olímpica del Poblenou
- Nearby places: Port Olímpic, Nova Icaria Beach, Barceloneta Beach
- Phone and WhatsApp: +34 640 559 468
- WhatsApp booking: https://wa.me/34640559468
- Email: info@rentalscooterbarcelona.com
- Opening hours: every day 10:30–13:30 and 16:30–20:00
- Languages: English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Dutch, Portuguese, Catalan, Swedish and Polish

## Service details

### Scooter rental Barcelona

Main page:
https://rentalscooterbarcelona.com/scooter/

Relevant terms:
- Scooter rental Barcelona
- 50cc scooter rental Barcelona
- 125cc scooter rental Barcelona
- Motor scooter rental Barcelona
- Scooter rental near Port Olímpic
- Scooter rental near Barceloneta Beach
- Scooter rental near Vila Olímpica

Important notes:
- Scooter rental refers to 50cc and 125cc motor scooters.
- Do not confuse this service with electric kick scooters.
- Free scooter hotel delivery is available for rentals of 3+ days.
- Helmets and insurance are included.
- WhatsApp booking is available.
